headlines.title: Stocks Rise as US, China Hail Positive Talks Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit
headlines.summary: The Trump-Xi summit is the biggest macro event on the tape this week — Bessent calling the weekend talks 'successful' is lighting a fire under risk assets across the board. You've got equities rallying, the long bond catching a bid, and US LNG names eyeing a tariff windfall if Beijing plays ball. Every sector from tech to agriculture to energy has skin in this game.

headlines.title: Fed's Goolsbee Says Path to 2% 'Unlikely to Be Painless'
headlines.summary: Goolsbee is putting the word 'stagflation' back in the room — that's a gut punch for anyone betting on a clean soft landing. When a Fed president starts talking about painful trade-offs between jobs and inflation, the rate path gets murky fast and bond traders get nervous. This hits everything from rate-sensitive growth stocks to the long bond.

headlines.title: Novo Nordisk's stock tumbles as doubts persist about Ozempic maker's goals for 2030
headlines.summary: Novo failing to excite the Street with its 2030 roadmap is a big deal — this stock has been the anchor of the entire GLP-1 trade, and when the pioneer stumbles, the whole obesity drug complex feels it. Watch for ripple effects on Eli Lilly and the broader biopharma tape as investors reassess how crowded this field is getting.
